title: Redibis QualityRuleSet v1alpha1
description: Portable, versioned quality rule set. apiVersion/kind follow a k8s/ODCS/OpenLineage-style envelope; every other field is snake_case, matching Redibis' existing JSON artifacts. Produced by redibis.quality.schema.rule_set_from_contract().

rule_set_id.description: Stable identity for this rule set — the physical table name by default.

semantic_digest.description: sha256[:16] of the serialized rule bodies — changes whenever rule content changes.

extensions.description: Namespaced escape hatch for fields not yet promoted to the core schema.

definition.description: Engine-native rule payload, verbatim (e.g. GE expectation_type + kwargs).

id.description: Contract-stable rule identity (survives edits — see redibis.contracts.rules.stable_rule_id).

metric.description: ODCS 3.1 metric vocabulary where possible: nullValues | missingValues | invalidValues | duplicateValues | rowCount. Null when metric_fidelity is 'unsupported'.

operator.description: ODCS 3.1 comparator: mustBe | mustNotBe | mustBeLessThan | mustBeGreaterThan | mustBeLessOrEqualTo | mustBeGreaterOrEqualTo | mustBeBetween.

metric_fidelity.description: lossless: exact ODCS 3.1 metric mapping. lossy: portable shape but a Redibis-specific metric name. unsupported: no portable metric — only the engine binding is authoritative.

stable_id.description: Execution-binding identity — hash of (expectation_type, column, kwargs). Used to match a run result to this rule, independent of contract edits.
